主要内容: SanDisk Corporation announced on March 25, 2013, that Dr. Khandker Quader, Senior Vice President of Memory Technology, Design and Product Development, will resign effective April 12, 2013, to pursue other opportunities. The resignation is effective April 12, 2013, and the company has not provided further details on the succession or impact of this change. The event occurred on March 21, 2013, and the filing was made on March 26, 2013, under Form 8-K. The resignation is part of the company's executive changes and may affect its operations and strategic direction in the technology sector.
